test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

There are many factories in the __operative __area of the city.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"operative"** means functioning or having effect. (संचालित)

 
 
• **Example: **The machinery is fully** operative **and ready for use.
 
 
 
• **"Industrial" **refers to anything related to industry or manufacturing. (औद्योगिक)
 
 
• **Example: **The **industrial **area of the city is filled with factories and warehouses.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for describing an area filled with factories is **'industrial'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **industrial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Serviceable **(सेवायोज्य): Capable of being used or of being useful.

 
 
• **Example:** The old car is still serviceable despite its age.
 
 
 
• **Industrious **(परिश्रमी ): Diligent and hard-working.
 
 
• **Example: **She is known to be an industrious student, always completing her assignments on time.
 
 
 
• **Mechanical** (यांत्रिक): Operated by a machine or machinery.
 
 
• **Example:** The factory uses mechanical processes to manufacture goods.
